metadata.short_desc: Collects stickers on its own and sends a fitting one while chatting
metadata.desc: Files away the stickers that show up in chat: a vision model classifies and tags them, and the plugin picks a semantically and emotionally fitting one when replying. Includes LLM tools for searching and collecting stickers (the model can pass work, character and action parameters directly), a WebUI library with batch import (configurable concurrency and rate limit), a review queue, duplicate cleanup, storage reclaim, and one-command data migration from astrbot_plugin_stealer.

steal_meme.hint: Monitors and saves images from chat. A vision model must be configured, otherwise images cannot be classified.

steal_mode.hint: Probability mode: random chance on each received image. Cooldown mode: enforce a minimum interval between collections.

steal_chance.hint: Set to 0 to never steal, set to 1 to steal every image. Recommended 0.2~0.5. Only takes effect in probability mode.

image_processing_cooldown.hint: Only used when collect mode is Cooldown: wait at least this many seconds between two pickups.

content_filtration.hint: Uses VLM to review image content and block inappropriate images. May increase processing time per image.

content_filtration_fail_open.description: Allow through when moderation itself fails
content_filtration_fail_open.hint: When enabled, an image counts as passed if the moderation call errors out (model timeout, quota exhausted, ...). When disabled (default) a failed check rejects the image, which is safer.

steal_pool_capacity.hint: Auto-stolen images go to the pending pool first. When this limit is reached, stealing pauses until items are reviewed (approved or deleted) in the WebUI. Changes take effect immediately, no restart needed.

audit_required.hint: When enabled, auto-stolen images go to the pending pool and require manual approval in the WebUI before being imported. When disabled, images auto-steal directly into the library. Pair with content moderation to avoid low-quality images.

qqofficial_steal_mode.hint: On QQ_Official, large stickers arrive as ordinary image attachments without the OneBot sub_type marker. By default only images carrying sticker-CDN traits (shop stickers and the like) are captured; you can also capture every image, or GIFs only.

llm_steal_param_mode.description: How to use collect parameters supplied by the LLM
llm_steal_param_mode.hint: Controls what happens when the persona LLM calls the collect tool and also supplies work, character or action parameters. Merge: take the fields the LLM gave and let the vision model fill in the rest (recommended). Prefer LLM: if the LLM supplied a work or a character, skip the vision model entirely - one call less and fastest. Vision only: ignore LLM parameters and behave like older versions.

auto_send_meme.hint: When enabled the bot sends stickers by itself during chats.

auto_meme_intent_gate.hint: When enabled, the plugin first judges whether a sticker suits this reply and skips the obviously unsuitable ones, which noticeably cuts down off-topic stickers. When disabled, only the send probability applies.

auto_meme_cancel_on_new_message.description: Cancel pending auto-send on new message
auto_meme_cancel_on_new_message.hint: Cancels the previous delayed auto-send when a new message arrives in the same session, preventing outdated replies with incorrect images.

meme_chance.hint: Set to 0 to never send, set to 1 to always send. Recommended 0.1~0.3 to avoid spamming.

send_meme_as_gif.hint: When enabled, always output as GIF for a native sticker feel. When disabled, send in original format (png/jpg/gif etc.). High-frequency sending of large GIFs may cause high memory usage.

meme_send_delay.hint: Delay before sending emoji to avoid conflicts with message-segmentation plugins. Recommended 5.0 s or more. Set to 0 to send immediately.

meme_send_delay_random.hint: When enabled the wait is drawn at random between the fixed delay and the max random delay, which reads more human. When disabled the fixed delay is always used.

meme_send_delay_max.hint: Only used when the random delay is on; it has to be larger than the fixed delay to matter.

meme_send_char_delay.hint: Adds waiting time proportional to the length of the bot reply, simulating read the text first, then send the sticker. Set to 0 to add nothing.

auto_meme_delivery_mode.hint: separate (default): the sticker is sent as its own message, same as before. attach: the sticker is appended to the message chain of the bot's reply, so reply-splitting plugins (such as outputpro_split) can see it and arrange it together with the text. attach has to pick the image before the reply goes out, which makes the reply slightly slower; on timeout or failure it falls back to separate automatically.

auto_meme_attach_timeout.hint: How long attach mode may spend picking a sticker. Past that it gives up attaching and sends a separate message asynchronously instead, so the reply itself is never held up. Only applies when delivery mode is attach.

auto_meme_attach_compat_split.description: Generate a compatible path for reply-splitting plugins
auto_meme_attach_compat_split.hint: Only applies when delivery mode is attach. Some reply-splitting plugins (outputpro_split) decide whether an image is a sticker by looking for the keyword plugin_stealer in its file path. When enabled, the sticker is linked into a compat folder containing that keyword before it is attached, so those plugins recognise it. Leave it off if upstream already supports this plugin directly.

smart_meme_selection.hint: When enabled, uses composite scoring (diversity + relevance + similarity) to pick the best emoji. When disabled, picks randomly (still avoids short-term repeats).

enable_natural_emotion_analysis.hint: When enabled, a lightweight model extracts search keywords and emotion priors from the AI reply to improve sticker matching. Whether to send is still controlled by the existing probability/cooldown gates. When disabled, the reply text is used directly.

emotion_analysis_provider_id.hint: Leave blank to use the current session model. A small-parameter model is sufficient; a lightweight free model is recommended to reduce latency and cost.

emotion_analysis_prompt.hint: Generates a search query and 1-3 emotion priors. Placeholders: {emotion_list}, {llm_reply}, {user_message}. Leave blank to use the default prompt. Legacy single-label output is still accepted.

vision_provider_id.hint: Used for image classification. Leave blank to auto-use AstrBot's global default_image_caption_provider_id.

enable_embedding_search.hint: When enabled, remote text embeddings recall stickers by overlay text + usage scenes + description. When disabled, keyword (BM25) search is used. No local CLIP. Falls back to BM25 if no embedding model is configured.

embedding_provider_id.hint: The embedding model used to generate semantic vectors for emoji. Leave blank to auto-use AstrBot's first available Embedding Provider. Check AstrBot Admin → LLM Config for configured embedding model IDs (typically ending in _embedding, e.g. openai_embedding, qwen_embedding). This is the embedding model ID, not the chat or vision model ID.

batch_analyze_concurrency.hint: How many images go to the vision model at the same time. 2-4 is a good range for hosted APIs; local deployments can go higher. Values that are too high trigger upstream 429 errors.

batch_analyze_rpm.hint: Maximum vision-analysis requests started per minute, to stay under upstream rate limits. Set to 0 for no limit, bounded only by concurrency. If you do not know your quota, start at roughly 70% of the RPM listed in the provider docs.

batch_analyze_max_retries.hint: How many times a single image is retried on recoverable errors such as 429, timeouts and 5xx. Unrecoverable errors like bad parameters or failed auth are not retried.

batch_analyze_retry_backoff.hint: Retry waits grow exponentially from this base (about base^n seconds on attempt n, with jitter, capped at 60s). When the provider returns Retry-After, that value wins.

send_target_whitelist.hint: Format: group:group_id or user:user_id. When non-empty, only whitelisted targets can receive stickers.

send_target_blacklist.hint: Format: group:group_id or user:user_id. Can be combined with whitelist; the priority rule below controls conflict resolution.

send_target_filter_mode.hint: Whitelist first: allow if whitelist hit, otherwise check blacklist. Blacklist first: deny if blacklist hit, otherwise check whitelist.

steal_target_whitelist.hint: Format: group:group_id or user:user_id. When non-empty, only whitelisted targets allow collection.

steal_target_blacklist.hint: Format: group:group_id or user:user_id. Can be combined with whitelist; the priority rule below controls conflict resolution.

steal_target_filter_mode.hint: Whitelist first: allow if whitelist hit, otherwise check blacklist. Blacklist first: deny if blacklist hit, otherwise check whitelist.

max_reg_num.hint: Library size limit; 0 means unlimited. Once exceeded, the oldest stickers are permanently deleted (favorites are kept) together with their image files, which cannot be recovered - hence the generous default.

capacity_auto_cleanup.hint: Off (default): only a log warning is emitted and nothing is deleted; run mp capacity manually when you want to clean up. On: an hourly background check permanently deletes the oldest stickers.

storage_cleanup_strategy.hint: Conservative: only dead index entries and temp files. Balanced: also orphaned files and the thumbnail cache. Aggressive: also the raw backup directory - saves the most space, but the originals are gone for good.

custom_meme_classification_prompt.hint: Supports placeholder: {emotion_list} (category list). Leave blank to use the default prompt.

custom_meme_classification_with_filter_p.hint: Used when content moderation is enabled. Supports placeholder: {emotion_list} (category list). Leave blank to use the default prompt.

webui_theme.hint: Used as the default until the page saves a theme of its own; once you switch themes inside Sticker Manager, the saved theme wins.

sim_weight_preset.hint: Preset controls how multiple similarity algorithms are fused: Balanced (default), Keyword-first (substring/character overlap), Semantic-first (n-gram/cosine), Strict (edit distance & character-level, reduces false sends).

pending.paused_hint: Stealing is paused and will resume after review.

empty.library_hint: Click "Add" to upload a new sticker.
empty.pending_hint: Newly stolen stickers will wait here for review.
empty.no_characters: No characters yet. Add one, then assign stickers in the library.

modal.keep_open_hint: You have unsaved input here, so clicking outside won't close it. Use × or Cancel to close.
modal.keep_open_busy_hint: Task progress is still showing in this window, so clicking outside won't close it. Use × in the corner to close.

messages.scene_input_hint: You can separate scenes with commas or semicolons.
messages.batch_work_hint: Leave empty to clear the work name on these stickers.

placeholders.work: Source work, e.g. Bocchi the Rock!

analysis.scenes_hint: Click to add or remove a chat line this sticker can reply to.

batch.drag_upload: Click or drag to upload multiple images
batch.supported_formats: Supports PNG, JPG, GIF, WEBP, BMP
batch.default_category_hint: Images will be saved into this category unless auto analyze is enabled.
batch.auto_analyze: Auto analyze each image and classify automatically
batch.auto_analyze_disabled_hint: Clear the selected category before enabling auto analyze.
batch.scope_hint: Images missing origin group info will be skipped when setting local scope.
batch.character_hint: This batch will be tagged with the selected character. You can change it later.
batch.cancel_confirm: Stop this import? Stickers already saved are kept.
batch.throttle_hint: Every image costs one vision-model call. Concurrency and the per-minute cap decide how fast requests go out - lower them to stay clear of upstream 429 errors. Set the per-minute cap to 0 to disable rate limiting. Throttled images are retried automatically with backoff, so nothing is lost.
batch.work_hint: One work name for the whole batch. It also becomes a search hint when the plugin looks for stickers.

alerts.batch_scope_partial: Updated {count} image(s). {skipped} skipped because origin group info is missing.
alerts.scope_origin_missing: This image is missing origin group info and cannot be set to local.
alerts.select_category_or_auto: Select a category or enable auto analyze.

Delete and blacklist this image?
It will no longer be auto-collected.
confirm.delete_image: Delete this image? This action cannot be undone.
confirm.storage_cleanup: Found {count} cleanable item(s). This will remove stale indexes, orphan files, thumbnail cache, and temp files. Continue?
confirm.delete_category: Delete category {key}? Images in this category will be deleted permanently.

prompt.origin_scope: Enter the origin scope, for example group:123456 or user:123456.

themes.title: Theme
themes.save_hint: Your pick is saved as the default theme.

characters.title: Characters
characters.hint: You assign characters in the dashboard. VLM does not detect them. Create a character first, then edit a card or batch-assign.
characters.bar_hint: Filter the library by character. Use Manage characters to add or remove them.

reanalyze.intro: Run vision analysis again over stickers already in the library to fill in or refresh tags, description, scenes, on-image text and emotions.
reanalyze.target_hint: "Missing labels" means stickers with no tags or no description - usually manual uploads or early imports.
reanalyze.overwrite_hint: When unchecked, only empty fields are filled and existing tags or descriptions stay untouched. When checked, analysis results replace the old values.
reanalyze.limit_hint: 0 means no extra limit. For large libraries, run a few smaller batches so you can check the results along the way.
reanalyze.category_note: Re-analysis never moves files, so categories are left unchanged. When the detected category differs from the current one it is listed as a suggestion for you to apply manually.
reanalyze.intro_pending: Run vision analysis again over images in the review queue to fill in or refresh category, tags, description, scenes, on-image text and emotions. Only the pending records change - nothing is approved automatically.
reanalyze.pending_tip: Re-run vision analysis over pending images in bulk, so labels are complete before you approve them
reanalyze.target_hint_pending: "Missing labels" means pending images with no tags or no description - usually left behind by a failed or timed-out analysis.
reanalyze.category_note_pending: A pending record's category is only a draft field and does not map to a real folder, so it is corrected here as well. Filing happens when you approve the image.
reanalyze.single_tip: Run vision analysis again; results only go into the edit form and are saved when you click Save
reanalyze.single_filled: Analysis results were filled into the form: {fields}. Nothing is written until you click Save - closing the dialog changes nothing.
reanalyze.single_same: The analysis matches what is already in the form, so there is nothing to change.
reanalyze.single_known: (passed 「{hints}」 to the model as known facts this time)
reanalyze.auto_switched: "{from}" has 0 images right now, so it switched to "{to}" automatically.
reanalyze.empty_library: The library is empty right now, so there is nothing to re-analyze.
reanalyze.empty_pending: The review queue is empty right now, so there is nothing to re-analyze.
reanalyze.scan_failed: Could not read the image counts - the backend or network may be down. Close and reopen this dialog to try again.
reanalyze.target_hint_no_desc: "No description" is the narrower option: it only picks entries whose description is empty. Those are effectively unsearchable, so they are worth fixing first.
reanalyze.target_empty: "{target}" has 0 images right now - pick a different scope before you start.

missing_desc.title: Missing descriptions
missing_desc.tip: Find entries with an empty description - the ones the list shows as "No description" - and fill them in one by one or re-analyze the whole batch
missing_desc.intro: These entries have no description, which is what the list shows as "No description". They are usually left behind by a timeout, upstream rate limiting, or a model that returned nothing. Description is the main thing search matches on, so an empty one is effectively unsearchable. Write one by hand, or hand the whole batch to bulk re-analysis.
missing_desc.empty: Nothing on this side is missing a description.
missing_desc.placeholder: Describe what the image expresses, e.g. a cat with wide eyes, completely shocked
missing_desc.analyze_tip: Run vision analysis again; the result only goes into the box and is written when you click Save Only
missing_desc.analyze_filled: The result went into the box. Click Save Only to write it.
missing_desc.analyze_empty: This run returned no description. Write one yourself, or try again later.
missing_desc.empty_draft: The description is still empty - type one, or click Analyze this one first.
missing_desc.truncated: The review queue holds {total} records; this check covered the newest {cap}. Clear this batch and reopen to keep going further down.
missing_desc.load_failed: Could not load the list - the backend or network may be down.
